items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I thought I was doing pretty good with Savoy and the tv and all that stuff.

ctx.x: There’s a variation of it in the hotel now.
That was considered a good spot. There were other places. Anyway, I thought I was doing pretty good with Savoy and the tv and all that stuff.
When you mentioned that they had remote at 5pm, did that meant the trio had to show up at the club?
